text: The research team published its results in a scientific journal.

text: Public transport reduces traffic and air pollution in the city centre.

text: Patients should consult a doctor before changing their medication.
reference: Les patients doivent consulter un médecin avant de changer leur médicament.

text: The government announced new funding for rural schools.

text: Climate change is a global challenge that requires international cooperation.
